name: BU-30B-A3B-Preview
notes: A preview release. The Hub API at revision 28f795cd lists 13 BF16 safetensors shards (31,070,754,032 parameters) in the Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration architecture; the repository is not gated. The card gives a 65,536-token context and quickstarts for BU Cloud (API key) and a local vLLM server, but no benchmark results, training data or training method, so its capability claims were not checked. The card metadata declares no license. The repository's LICENSE is a modified MIT text that withholds all rights from anyone whose company or employer has global consolidated annual revenue above US$1 million (measured for the preceding month), and points them to a commercial license or the hosted service instead.
summary: Browser Use's open-weight browser-agent model, fine-tuned from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct (30B total, 3B active parameters) to serve as the LLM of the browser-use library through BU Cloud or vLLM.
